items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Wins Two FDA Approvals And A $3.35 Billion Drug Alliance
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) received FDA approval for Olumiant to treat pediatric patients with severe alopecia areata. The FDA also cleared once weekly insulin Onswik for adults with type 2 diabetes, adding a new dosing option. Eli Lilly agreed a global drug discovery alliance with InnoCare Pharma valued at up to US$3.35b in research and licensing commitments.
